title: Install AI SDK Dependencies and Configure Environment
description: Install the Vercel AI SDK and OpenAI client library, then configure the necessary environment variables for AI integration.
details: Install `ai`, `@ai-sdk/react`, and `openai` packages using npm/yarn. Add the OpenAI API key to `.env.local` as `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Update the project's TypeScript configuration if needed to support the new dependencies. Verify the installation by checking that all packages are properly listed in package.json and that the environment variable is accessible in the development environment.
test_strategy: Verify installation by importing the AI SDK in a test file and checking that environment variables are properly loaded. Run `npm run build` to ensure no TypeScript errors are introduced.

title: Create Protected Chat API Route
description: Implement a secure API endpoint at `/api/chat` that handles chat requests, integrates with OpenAI, and streams responses back to the client.
details: Create `app/api/chat/route.ts` with a POST handler that: 1) Validates user authentication using the existing Better Auth session, 2) Extracts message history from the request body, 3) Uses the Vercel AI SDK's `streamText` function with OpenAI's GPT-4o model, 4) Returns a streaming response. Include proper error handling for authentication failures, API rate limits, and malformed requests. Use Zod for request validation and ensure the route follows Next.js App Router conventions.
test_strategy: Create integration tests to verify authentication middleware works correctly, test successful chat completion with mock OpenAI responses, and test error handling for unauthenticated requests and API failures.

title: Build Interactive Chat Interface Component
description: Create a reusable chat interface component using shadcn/ui components and the Vercel AI SDK's useChat hook for state management.
details: Create `components/ui/chat-interface.tsx` that: 1) Uses the `useChat` hook from `@ai-sdk/react` to manage chat state and API communication, 2) Renders messages in a scrollable area using `ScrollArea` component, 3) Includes an input field and send button using `Input` and `Button` components, 4) Displays loading states during AI response streaming, 5) Handles error states with appropriate user feedback, 6) Supports both light and dark themes. Ensure the component is fully typed with TypeScript and follows React best practices for performance.
test_strategy: Write component tests using React Testing Library to verify message rendering, user input handling, loading states, and error scenarios. Test keyboard navigation and accessibility features.

title: Integrate Chat Interface into Dashboard
description: Replace the placeholder content in the dashboard page with the new chat interface component and ensure proper layout and styling.
details: Modify `app/dashboard/page.tsx` to: 1) Import and render the `ChatInterface` component, 2) Remove existing placeholder content, 3) Ensure the chat interface is properly centered and responsive, 4) Add appropriate padding and spacing using Tailwind CSS classes, 5) Verify the component works correctly within the existing dashboard layout and theme system. Test that the chat interface maintains proper proportions on different screen sizes and integrates seamlessly with the existing navigation and theme toggle.
test_strategy: Perform end-to-end testing to verify the complete user flow: login, navigate to dashboard, send a chat message, and receive a streamed AI response. Test responsive design on different screen sizes and verify theme switching works correctly.
